snippet.title: The Elder Scrolls Online - Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Worm Cult has returned to threaten the island paradise of Solstice in the Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1. Venture into a new zone, never-before-seen in the Elder Scrolls, and discover new stories, allies, and dangers as you uncover the dread plans of the resurgent Worm Cult in a sequel saga 10 years in the making. The Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 is now live on PC/Mac and arrives June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.

Visit elderscrollsonline.com for more information and all the latest reveals and news. 

Official Site: https://www.elderscrollsonline.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TESOnline
Instagram: https://instagram.com/elderscrollsonline

ESRB Rating: MATURE with Blood and Gore, Sexual Themes, Use of Alcohol, and Violence. Online interactions not rated by the ESRB.
